name: @presslabz/theme-kit
//: The contract a theme satisfies. It exports types, one declaration function and the two components every theme must not reimplement — never a component a theme could style. What a theme may do is decided here; how it looks is decided there.
//exports: A wildcard rather than an entry per component. Adding one to an explicit map changes package.json, and a dev server already running caches a package's export conditions: the new component resolves to "is not exported" until somebody restarts it, with nothing to suggest that is the cause. Only components live in src/*.astro, so the wildcard exposes exactly what it should.
